allow: PowerShell($nb = Get-Content notebooks/01_data_exploration.ipynb -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; foreach \($i in @\(7,9,11\)\) { Write-Output "==== Cell $i \($\($nb.cells[$i].id\)\) ===="; foreach \($out in $nb.cells[$i].outputs\) { if \($out.output_type -eq 'stream'\) { Write-Output \($out.text -join ''\) } } })

PowerShell($nb = Get-Content notebooks/05_explainability.ipynb -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; foreach \($i in 0..\($nb.cells.Count-1\)\) { $c = $nb.cells[$i]; if \($c.cell_type -ne 'code'\) { continue }; $errs = @\($c.outputs | Where-Object { $_.output_type -eq 'error' }\).Count; $imgs = @\($c.outputs | Where-Object { $_.data.'image/png' }\).Count; $streams = @\($c.outputs | Where-Object { $_.output_type -eq 'stream' }\).Count; Write-Output \("cell {0:D2} \({1,-18}\) errors={2} images={3} streams={4}" -f $i, $c.id, $errs, $imgs, $streams\) })

PowerShell($nb = Get-Content notebooks/05_explainability.ipynb -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Output "==== Cell 13 shap-run ====" ; foreach \($out in $nb.cells[13].outputs\) { if \($out.output_type -eq 'stream'\) { $txt = if \($out.text -is [array]\) { $out.text -join '' } else { $out.text }; $lines = $txt -split "`n"; $tail = $lines[-8..-1] -join "`n"; Write-Output "...[truncated head]..."; Write-Output $tail } })

PowerShell($nb = Get-Content notebooks/05_explainability.ipynb -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $cell = $nb.cells[14]; $imgs = @\($cell.outputs | Where-Object { $_.data.'image/png' }\); Write-Output "shap-display: $\($imgs.Count\) images"; $tmpDir = "$env:TEMP\\nb05-rerun"; for \($i = 1; $i -lt [Math]::Min\(3, $imgs.Count\); $i++\) { $b64 = $imgs[$i].data.'image/png'; $bytes = [Convert]::FromBase64String\($b64\); $out = "$tmpDir\\sample_$i.png"; [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes\($out, $bytes\); Write-Output "saved $out" })
